newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico tax revenues up 10 pct this year-Finance.
newsitem.headline: Mexico tax revenues up 10 pct this year-Finance.

text.p: Mexico's tax revenues have risen about 10 percent so this year, the deputy minister for income at the Finance Ministry, Tomas Ruiz, said on Tuesday.
"It is an important increase on the average of about 10 percent," Ruiz said, speaking to reporters after the government released an economic development plan to the year 2000.
Ruiz's figure compared tax revenues so far this year to the same period last year, a Finance Ministry spokesman said.
"The trend that we started to see in the last half of 1996 is that there was an improvement in the tax collections, and that this has consolidated in the first months of the year," he said.
